chunks: Harun ibn Muslim narrated from Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
Ali, peace be upon him, said: “Injustice in a will is among the major sins.”

key_terms.الْحَيْفُ: injustice, unfair bias, or wrongful deviation from justice
key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةِ: a bequest or will made concerning one’s estate

ai.seo_question: Is injustice in a will considered one of the major sins in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that committing injustice in a bequest or will is counted among the major sins. It underscores the grave moral and legal seriousness of violating fairness in the distribution of one's estate.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5420 - Harun ibn Muslim narrated from Masadah ibn Ṣadaqah from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Injustice in a will is among the major sins."
